title: EmDash picture lines are reported at the media address the site draws them
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: The EmDash contract apply answers placed (file name to /_emdash/api/media/file/<key>) and a placed picture's report line is ordered at that address.

tests: pictures: the path the run uploaded becomes the library item, found by its upload or by its file name
